interface.longDescription: EmberBanter Studio: Music. Games. Stories. Gaming, streaming and podcasts with a private laptop creator hub. Prepared toolkit 0.8.0 adds private Windows-protected OBS profiles, read-only setup diagnostics, unavailable capture-folder recovery and append-only owner rehearsal reports. OBS profile changes invalidate old control approvals. Generate local narration, save scene films, finish captured episodes and prepare private platform handoff drafts. Twenty-three local MCP tools inspect, save creative plans and propose exact actions; owner-only approvals and rehearsal attestations stay in the hub. The new Windows credential path and rendered device layouts await actual device acceptance while DTG is offline; 0.7.0 is the last verified laptop installation. Phone control needs private HTTPS. This package creates no hosted mobile bridge, public go-live, upload, messaging or platform scheduling connection.
